title.en: Answering the Phone and Taking Messages

scene.ko: 회사로 걸려 온 전화를 받고, 회의 중인 동료 대신 메시지를 받는다.

lines.en: Good morning, Dasol Tech. Minji speaking.
alt: Hello, Dasol Tech. This is Minji.

lines.en: Hi. Could I speak to David Wilson, please?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 데이비드 윌슨 씨와 통화할 수 있을까요?

lines.en: I'm sorry, he's in a meeting right now.
alt: Sorry, he's in a meeting now.
I'm afraid he's in a meeting.

lines.en: Okay. Can I leave a message?
Sure. May I have your name?
It's Tom Baker. Please ask him to call me.
lines.ko: 톰 베이커예요. 저한테 전화 좀 달라고 전해 주세요.

lines.en: Okay, Mr. Baker. I'll tell him.
alt: Got it. I'll let him know.
Sure. I'll give him your message.

expressions.en: He's in a meeting right now.
expressions.note: 자리에 없을 때는 He's not at his desk.
Who's calling, please? 도 많이 씀
